//: PRODUCTION CONFIG. Every REPLACE_WITH_* value below MUST be set before go-live. See backend/DEPLOYMENT.md. Prefer environment variables / IIS config / user-secrets for passwords rather than committing real secrets here (double-underscore syntax, e.g. ConnectionStrings__InnovationDb, Smtp__Password).
//ConnectionStrings: REQUIRED, and intentionally EMPTY here so no credentials are committed. Supply it at runtime via the ConnectionStrings__InnovationDb environment variable (a Railway variable). Azure SQL shape: Server=tcp:i2i-testing-raid.database.windows.net,1433;Initial Catalog=InnovationToImpact;Persist Security Info=False;User ID=admin-i2i;Password=<SQL_PASSWORD>;MultipleActiveResultSets=False;Encrypt=True;TrustServerCertificate=False;Connection Timeout=30; -- EF migrations are applied automatically on startup.
//DevAuth: TEMP FOR TESTING. AlwaysOn=true replaces Negotiate/LDAP with the X-Dev-User header scheme in Production, so the Railway container works without a domain controller. SamAccountName is the account used when a request has no X-Dev-User header; 'devuser' is seeded with every role (Innovator, Evaluator, Committee, Supervisor, Admin). Set AlwaysOn to false (or DevAuth__AlwaysOn=false) before a real domain-joined install.
//ActiveDirectory: REQUIRED. Used only in Production for LDAP identity resolution. ServiceAccount* should be a read-only domain account (or the app-pool identity's own domain user). Domain is the AD FQDN, e.g. corp.example.com.
//Smtp: REQUIRED. Production sends real email through this server. Leave Username/Password EMPTY to authenticate as the app-pool Windows identity against an internal relay; set them only if the relay needs an explicit login. RedirectAllToEmail must stay EMPTY for normal delivery.
//Storage: Absolute server paths for uploaded and generated files; the app identity needs read/write. These are LINUX container paths for the Railway/Docker deployment — on a Windows/IIS install replace them with C:\InnovationToImpact\storage\* . Railway containers have an ephemeral filesystem, so mount a volume at /app/storage to keep uploads across redeploys.
//EmailOutbox: Optional. Max delivery attempts before an outbox item is marked Failed.
